2) SCIM API docs (attached: redwood-scim-api-spec.pdf) — endpoints, auth, rate limits, and common mappings.
3) RBAC & admin controls (attached: redwood-rbac-admin-matrix.xlsx) — built-in roles, custom roles, privilege separation, and audit logging.
4) SOC 2 Type II report + pentest summary — we will provide via secure upload; please confirm preferred upload mechanism.

- I'll loop in Marissa (CS/PS) and Dev (technical) to schedule a short integration call if helpful.
